title: feat(plugin-grid): phone cards follow the object's highlightFields for their amount and subtitle
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAvhxsnErQnmY8cTbgC3beU)_

Fixes #37891
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwy7XB37e8e1P6jRJ3

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：在手机上看列表和相关列表时，卡片按对象声明的「最重要字段」显示：右下角是其中第一个金额（订单明细显示这一行的合计，不再是单价），副标题依次显示后面最多三个字段，数字类带名称，例如「数量 2 · 单价 ¥6,000.00 · 折扣 10.00%」；电脑上的宽表格不变。
- 为什么做：HotCRM 订单明细的手机卡片只写「1 · 2」、右下角是单价，要改只能动宽表格的列顺序；你 11 月 28 日选了「按对象的最重要字段」，不加新配置。
- 出错会怎样：声明了「最重要字段」的对象，手机卡片都会跟着变（事先粗量约 222 处里 180 处，大多在 HotCRM），哪个对象读着不对，调它的「最重要字段」顺序即可；整个改动可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Governing ruling: the maintainer chose option A on #37891 (ruling record 7235312203, 2026-11-28T06:25Z, anchor 7235198146): phone cards follow the object's `highlightFields` (ADR-0085 §1), no new key, no line-number title prefix. Built as the claim (7235321485) and its surface amendment (seat, 2026-11-28T06:31Z) say.

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (`buildMobileCardRenderer`): when the object declares `highlightFields`, the card body is that list, in order (title excluded): the amount is the first entry that draws as money (#37890's `drawsAsMoney`), the subtitle the next three, skipping the status field and the title formula's reads, empty values dropped (0 is a value), and a number, currency or percent part (a formula or summary by its value type) is drawn under its field label (`grid-card-subtitle-label`). A highlighted field the view shows is drawn through its column draft; one it does not show through the synthesized draft. Masked fields stay masked: never the amount, never a part. An object without `highlightFields` keeps the column-order card (two unlabelled parts).
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx`: the synthesized path's per-field draft is now its own callback, `synthesizeFieldColumn` (same body: renderer, translated label, FLS), which `generateColumns` calls and the card reuses. No behaviour change for columns.
- Fetches, beside the declared name field and through the same gates (declared, FLS-readable, not draft-only/withheld/redacted), on every viewport so a width change never refetches:
  - `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridRowLoad.ts` `getSelectFields` (the grid's own fetch);
  - `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` harvest (the list page's fetch);
  - `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` `selectFields` (the related list's fetch; derived-columns lists still send no projection).
- Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch, naming the phone-card change.

## Tests
- `plugin-grid` `phoneCardAmount-34615.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (HotCRM order-line fixture at 390 px): amount = highlighted total (CN¥10,800.00) though the table shows the unit price first; subtitle `Quantity 2 · Sales Price CN¥6,000.00 · Discount % 10.00%`; a text part drawn bare; an empty part dropped; a highlighted field no column shows is drawn and is in the grid's `$select`; CONTROL no `highlightFields` keeps `1 · 2` and the unit price, no labels; CONTROL a `password` field first in `highlightFields` is neither amount nor part and its value is never printed.
- `plugin-list` `ListView.harness.test.tsx`, new top-level describe: a highlighted field no column shows is in `$select` and not drawn; CONTROL no `highlightFields` sends the old projection.
- `plugin-detail` `RelatedList.selectFls-10186.test.tsx`, new top-level describe: a declared, readable highlighted field is requested, an undeclared one never; an FLS-denied one is not requested; CONTROL no `highlightFields` keeps the projection.

## Acceptance notes
- The fetches ask for `highlightFields` on desktop too (a few extra columns per row), as they already ask for the name field, so crossing the 768 px breakpoint never refetches.
- The status chip is unchanged: drawn when a column shows the status field; the status field is never a subtitle part.
- The related list's non-enlarged mobile gallery (`object-gallery`) path is untouched (#37008 owns its labels).
- No "×" joiner and no title prefix, by the ruling. The HotCRM `highlightFields` re-order (order line, quote line, and a review of its other objects) follows in its own card after this lands, per the anchor's 裁后执行.
- Measured before the ruling (anchor 7235198146, static simulation): 180 of 222 shipped phone-card surfaces change, 134 of 138 on HotCRM; platform objects only gain a third part.

## Verification
Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardAmount-34615.test.tsx -t highlightFields`, expect the objectstack#37891 describe green (7 cases).

First files to read (by risk): `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (the card body and the label rule); `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx` (the extracted draft, must be byte-equivalent for columns); `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` (the projection arm and its gates).

Verification record: every reading below is on `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, base `origin/main` 4f7aa88a, through `os-verify-lock.sh`, after rebuilding the closure (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' --filter='@object-ui/plugin-list^...' --filter='@object-ui/plugin-detail^...'`, 58/58).
